summary: Global Partners LP filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026 disclosing entry into the Twelfth Amendment to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, with the Partnership as guarantor and certain subsidiaries as borrowers. Terms extend facility maturity from March 20, 2028 to October 16, 2031, maintain the $1.0 billion working capital and $500 million revolver commitments, reduce the extended working capital interim commitment to $0, and reassign certain lender loans and commitments. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations element is present; this is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
